newsitem.title: FRANCE: SIDO raises French rapeseed export target to EU.
newsitem.headline: SIDO raises French rapeseed export target to EU.

text.p: The French oilseeds and protein seeds association SIDO raised its estimate for rapeseed exports to the rest of the European Union, citing sustained demand from Germany, the UK and the Netherlands.

In its January report released on Thursday, SIDO said France may export a record 1.575 million tonnes of rapeseed to other European Union countries in 1996/97 against 1.550 million forecast in November and 1.264 million exported in 1995/96.
Total exports were kept unchanged from November at 1.825 million tonnes. This would compare with a total 1.298 million tonnes exported in 1995/96.
SIDO revised downwards its crushings estimate to 730,000 tonnes from 750,000 tonnes in November and 1.005 million tonnes in 1995/96.

"At end-December 1996 the volume of rapeseed crushings is 180,000 tonnes behind the 1995/96 level. Assuming a monthly crushing pace of 60,000 tonnes during the second half of the campaign, the November forecast has been adjusted to 730,000 tonnes," SIDO said.
SIDO kept unchanged its rapeseed output target of 2.87 million tonnes. This would represent a rise of six percent over the 2.7 million tonnes produced in 1995/96.
France would end the 1996/97 season with rapeseed stocks of 70,000 tonnes against 50,000 tonnes forecast in November and 85,000 tonnes at end June 1996, SIDO said.
